moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: Arsenal and Manchester City clash today in the annual curtain-raiser for the English football season at Cardiff's Principality Stadium.

angles.name: Match Hype
angles.copy: Today! The Community Shield kicks off the new season as Arsenal take on Manchester City. Who are you backing for the first silverware?

angles.name: Welsh Local Angle
angles.copy: The Principality Stadium in Cardiff hosts a massive game today as Arsenal face Man City in the Community Shield. Great to have such a big fixture in Wales!

moments.title: Championship Season Begins
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship kicks off today, with West Ham United facing Burnley live on Sky Sports, and Watford taking on Southampton.

angles.name: Season Start
angles.copy: The Championship is back! West Ham United are away to Burnley in today's big kick-off, live on Sky Sports. Who's ready for some second-tier drama?

angles.name: Local Team Focus
angles.copy: Watford also get their Championship campaign underway today against Southampton. Huge season ahead for all these clubs!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Concludes
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, Wales' renowned independent music and arts event in the Brecon Beacons, wraps up its 2026 edition today.

angles.name: Festival Farewell
angles.copy: It's the final day of Green Man Festival! What an incredible weekend of music, arts and good vibes in the Brecon Beacons. Who was there?

angles.name: Welsh Festival Pride
angles.copy: Another fantastic Green Man Festival comes to a close today in the beautiful Welsh countryside. We're already buzzing for next year!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Madonna
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday today, August 16, continuing her reign as one of music's most influential artists.

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Madonna! From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', she's still got us dancing.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: 68 today! Madonna has redefined pop music for decades. What's your all-time favourite track from the Queen of Pop?

moments.title: Vanessa Carlton is 46
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Vanessa Carlton, known for her hit single 'A Thousand Miles,' celebrates her 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Sing-along Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to Vanessa Carlton! We're definitely walking a thousand miles down memory lane with her biggest hit today.

angles.name: 00s Throwback
angles.copy: It's Vanessa Carlton's birthday! 'A Thousand Miles' is still an absolute anthem. What's your favourite 00s piano pop track?

moments.title: Ariana Grande at The O2
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Ariana Grande continues her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' with a show at London's O2 Arena tonight, and again on August 19th.

angles.name: Pop Spectacle
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is at The O2 tonight for her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour'! Expect hits, high notes, and stunning visuals. Who's going?

angles.name: London Gig
angles.copy: London is buzzing tonight as Ariana Grande brings her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' to The O2. A must-see for pop fans!

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd continues his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' with a performance at Wembley Stadium in London tonight, with further dates on August 18th and 19th.

angles.name: Stadium Show
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium lights up tonight for The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour'! Get ready for a massive show.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: Another huge night for London music fans! The Weeknd takes over Wembley Stadium with his incredible 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour'.

moments.title: BBC Proms Continues
moments.blurb: The BBC Proms season is in full swing at the Royal Albert Hall, with concerts today featuring the Swedish Chamber Orchestra and Elgar's Cello Concerto.

angles.name: Classical Highlight
angles.copy: Experience the magic of the BBC Proms today at the Royal Albert Hall, with performances including Elgar's Cello Concerto. A true British institution!

angles.name: London Culture
angles.copy: The BBC Proms continue to enchant audiences in London. What a cultural highlight in the heart of the city!

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart this week with 'Rein Me In', followed by Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai'.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at No. 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' reigns supreme on the Official Singles Chart. Is it your favourite right now?

angles.name: Top 5 Buzz
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy are holding strong at No. 2, with Ella Langley, Hugel/Imael Angel/Ultra Nate, and Olivia Rodrigo completing the Top 5. What's your pick of the chart?

moments.title: Robert Plant Turns 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: On August 20th, we're wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to the iconic voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant! What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate a rock legend! Robert Plant turns 78 this Thursday. His influence is still massive!

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns on Friday with Arsenal vs. Coventry City. Who's excited for the new season?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive weekend of football! The Premier League kicks off on Friday, with Hull City vs. Man Utd among Saturday's big games. Predictions?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Begin
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals return from August 21st to 26th, bringing a massive lineup of music to two sites across the UK.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festivals kick off this Friday! Who are you most looking forward to seeing on the main stage?

angles.name: Yorkshire Excitement
angles.copy: Leeds Festival is almost here! Get ready for a huge weekend of music in Bramham Park. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Liam Payne Turns 33
moments.blurb: Former One Direction member Liam Payne celebrates his 33rd birthday on Friday, August 21st.

angles.name: Boyband Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to Liam Payne this Friday! From One Direction superstardom to solo success, what's your favourite of his tracks?

angles.name: 1D Throwback
angles.copy: Wishing Liam Payne a fantastic birthday on Friday! Who remembers his One Direction days?
